name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the platform as shown in Homebridge.

username.title: Cync Email
username.description: Email address you use to sign in to the Cync app.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Code (OTP)
twoFactor.description: Temporary 6-digit code emailed by Cync when you sign in. Leave blank normally; only needed when performing a fresh login.

unreachableStatePolicy.title: Unreachable Accessory State
unreachableStatePolicy.description: How HomeKit should represent an accessory that has not reported state within the timeout. No Response is the most accurate default.

unreachableTimeoutSeconds.title: Unreachable Timeout
unreachableTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds since the last device update before the accessory is treated as unreachable.

deviceShowConfigs.title: Shows by Device
deviceShowConfigs.description: Per-device show selections managed by the custom plugin UI.
